fields.what_it_is: The basic shape of the TASMIN R devices is a hollow structural frame having a rounded, tapered leading face. The upper and lower aspects of the implant are open with peaked teeth that assist in anchoring and seating the implant between the vertebral bodies. There are lateral fenestrations for bony in-growth. the device is avaible in a variety of sizes and angulations thereby enabling the surgeon to choose the size best suited to the individual pathology and anatomical condition.
